Good afternoon 
It may occur from time to time.
Causes:
- no Bluetooth connection 
- bad sensor( no Bluetooth connection)

In order to check go into your iPhone parameters in chapter Bluetooth, you should see abbot device. If not it is not connected. 
 Then you can stop and restart your iPhone.

If you have changed nothing on your mobile phone the best is to change sensor and contact abbot for replacement…
